title: Do the pen workflow deck's fault, set-count and feed-switch screens go into the Astra prototype?
detail: The pen workflow deck draws report fault, resolve fault, set count (5 screens) and switch formula as designed flows. The Astra prototype has none of them reachable; its own fault views are built but no control opens them. The deck's screens are in the atlas as in-design. Environment's PRD says Inspection no longer carries maintenance, which would move the fault flow out of this feature.
options: Build them into the Astra prototype under the pen sheet and Actions
Keep them as the reference design and move the fault flow to Environment
Drop the deck screens and delete the unreachable code

title: Keep the Remove from batch reason page, or only Batch membership's Remove option?
detail: The prototype has two ways to take a sow out of her batch. Batch membership (shown as pig-profile.batch-membership) offers Remove from batch with no reason. A separate page asks for a reason (assigned in error, not due in this window, other) but nothing opens it now: the Actions sheet hides the host action it came from. It is left out of the atlas for that reason.
options: Keep Batch membership only; delete the reason page
Make Batch membership's Remove option open the reason page
Show the reason page as a screen and give it a door

title: Is Assign identity here the same flow as Piglet processing's Give IDs?
detail: The place workflow deck draws Assign identity (tag keypad, notch, parents, sex) for any no-ID pig, with a breeding-stock gate. Piglet processing's simple prototype also gives IDs one piglet at a time with weights on the keypad. Both pre-fill the next tag and save per pig. The docs do not say which owns the flow or whether one sheet serves both.
options: One shared identity sheet, owned by Pig list, opened from Piglet processing
Two flows: piglets in Tasks, other pigs here
Fold identity into the pig record
